data.standardized_narrative: At the start of 2015 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 553.885m. During 2015 there was an aggregate favourable development on prior accident years, with an estimated gross prior-year release of approximately GBP 32.9m (about 5.9% of opening gross claims outstanding). The release was driven by favourable claims development and low catastrophe activity together with favourable development of existing reserves; the report states that all business units other than Property and Commercial benefited from prior year reserve improvements, with Casualty, Professional, Marine and Aviation explicitly noted as benefiting.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development of prior year reserves

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was not provided as a single explicit gross figure in the prior-year movement note. A net release (GBP 52,922k) is stated in the notes; to produce a gross prior-year movement I computed the gross prior-year development from the gross claims development table (claims triangle). The gross PYD derived from the triangle is approximately -GBP 32.926m (a release). The net/gross discrepancy (net release GBP 52.922m vs gross release ~GBP 32.926m) arises because the report explicitly states the NET release and the reinsurers' share movements differ; the triangle-based gross calculation is used here per methodology rules (confidence 0.8).
